what: Brookfield Wealth Solutions sells annuities and pension risk transfer in North America and takes over blocks of policies from other insurers. The money backing those promises is invested by Brookfield.
customers: Retirees buying annuities, and companies handing their pension obligations to an insurer.
money: retirement income policies and transferred pension plans
policy books taken over from other insurers
moat: Access to Brookfield's private credit, infrastructure and property investments, which earn more than the bonds a traditional insurer holds against the same liabilities.
risks: 30 times earnings on a business whose reported profit swings with investment marks
Annuity liabilities last decades while the assets behind them include illiquid investments
No analyst coverage in the data, so there is little independent scrutiny
opportunities: $3.2B of free cash flow and $13.5B of cash against $205M of debt
Revenue grew from $1.0B to $11.6B in four years as it acquired policy blocks
Higher interest rates make annuities both easier to sell and more profitable to write
watch: Annuity inflows and the spread earned over what is credited to policyholders.
